findings.title: Unclear scope of site establishment
findings.message: The short and long text only state "Baustelle vollständig einrichten und vorhalten" without specifying required facilities, equipment, duration or standards, which violates VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 (eindeutig, erschöpfend).
findings.suggestion: Detail the required facilities (e.g., offices, storage, sanitation), duration of provision and any applicable standards (e.g., DIN 18363).

findings.title: Missing technical specifications for frost protection layer
findings.message: The description lacks material type, required thickness, thermal conductivity and performance class, which are mandatory according to STLB‑Bau standard texts for frost protection.
findings.suggestion: Specify the frost protection material (e.g., granular, geotextile), minimum thickness (e.g., 30 mm), and thermal conductivity value.

findings.title: Insufficient data for PE‑HD pipe supply
findings.message: The text does not state pressure class, SDR, required standards or accessories (e.g., fittings, jointing system), which are required for a complete specification.
findings.reference: VOB/C DIN 18331; STLB‑Bau technical data for PE‑HD pipelines
findings.suggestion: Add pressure rating (e.g., PN 16), SDR value, reference to DIN EN 12201, and list required fittings and jointing method.

findings.title: Missing technical details for shaft construction
findings.message: No concrete class, reinforcement details, dimensions or installation method are provided, contrary to the STLB‑Bau requirement for shaft works.
findings.suggestion: Specify concrete grade (e.g., C25/30), reinforcement layout, shaft dimensions and connection details for the prefabricated elements.

findings.title: Lacking mortar and binding class for masonry
findings.message: Only wall thickness is given; the type of mortar, binding class and any reinforcement are missing, which are required for Kalksandsteinmauerwerk.
findings.suggestion: Add mortar type (e.g., M5), binding class (e.g., K2), and any reinforcement or tie‑bars required.

findings.title: Missing material and thickness for interior plaster
findings.message: The specification does not state plaster type, thickness, or applicable standards, which are necessary for a complete interior finish.
findings.suggestion: Define plaster material (e.g., gypsum, lime), nominal thickness (e.g., 12 mm), and reference to DIN 18550.

findings.title: Insufficient data for cement screed
findings.message: No screed thickness, reinforcement, or drying time is indicated, which are required by the technical standard for CT‑C25‑F4.
findings.suggestion: Add required screed thickness (e.g., 45 mm), reinforcement mesh, and curing period.

findings.title: Missing specifications for paving slab work
findings.message: The description does not include stone size, joint width, or class of the paving material, which are required for a complete execution.
findings.suggestion: Specify paving unit size (e.g., 100 × 100 mm), joint width (e.g., 3 mm), and material class (e.g., C‑2).

findings.title: Lacking technical data for asphalt base layer
findings.message: No gradation, binder content, or minimum thickness is provided, which are mandatory for asphalt layers.
findings.suggestion: Add required gradation (e.g., AC‑16), binder content (e.g., 5 % bitumen), and minimum thickness (e.g., 30 mm).

findings.title: Missing technical data for asphalt wearing course
findings.message: The specification does not state surface texture, binder content, or thickness, which are required for the wearing course.
findings.suggestion: Specify surface texture (e.g., stone‑matted), binder content (e.g., 4 % bitumen), and thickness (e.g., 25 mm).

findings.title: Potential missing sub‑performance for frost protection
findings.message: Installation of frost protection usually requires sub‑performance such as sub‑grade preparation and compaction, which are not listed as separate positions and could be claimed as additional work.
findings.suggestion: Add a separate position for sub‑grade preparation and compaction or explicitly include it in the scope.

findings.title: Potential missing foundation work for shaft
findings.message: Creating a shaft from prefabricated concrete parts normally requires foundation excavation and concrete footings, which are not separately specified and may be claimed as extra work.
findings.suggestion: Include a separate position for shaft foundation excavation and footing concrete.
